Small-business questions

Before you switch.

Is PestFlow suitable for a small team?

The published Starter plan supports one branch with defined staff, technician and monthly-job limits.

Must we migrate every old record?

No. A practical rollout can begin with active customers, current agreements and upcoming work.

Does every technician need office access?

No. Role-based access keeps technicians focused on assigned field work.

Can the plan grow with us?

Professional and Enterprise plans publish higher operating limits.
